Remark
[Limits obtained by a third dilation] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0263, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0264 1. Notes 8.26\group dilations-of-infinite-time-singularities

Starting from a Type II ancient solution, one may choose points and times $t_i\searrow -\infty $ and dilate again to obtain an eternal pointed limit that satisfies \[ \sup |\Rm _{2\infty }|\le 1 = |\Rm _{2\infty }(x_{2\infty },0)|. \]
